resources.string: Six rhythm lanes and a horizontal Field touch controller
USB controller · Connect through ADB reverse
USB connected · Focus the selected game window

Fit centers the complete picture without distortion. Side bars preserve the chart on wide phones. Crop can hide incoming notes or the judgment line. Overlay keeps the picture centered on the screen; Reserved makes it smaller above the lanes.
Requests smoother touch feedback on supported screens. Video FPS is separate. Power saving and device settings can limit the actual refresh rate.

Higher buttons extend upward without moving the picture or judgment lines. Field uses horizontal movement in the area above the buttons. Phone Field edges apply to fixed layouts; use Align game judgment lines for the aligned layout.
Automatic connection looks for Host through ADB reverse while this app is open. Start Host and run setup-adb.ps1 on your PC first. Disconnect stops retries until you connect again or reopen the app.
Game Field edges and video quality are configured on your PC. Run Host with --calibrate to save the game area; use --resolution, --fps and --bitrate for video quality.
Left edge must be smaller than right edge.
Saved settings were invalid. Defaults are in use.
Settings could not be saved. Changes remain active for this session.
Tap the leftmost comfortable position in the Field area.
Now tap the rightmost comfortable position.
Highlighted area maps from the game Field left edge to its right edge. Save to apply.
Choose a right edge at least 5% of the screen to the right of the left edge.

Aligned layout follows the upper Field line, four central Floor lanes and two slanted side lanes. Calibrate while the gameplay lines are visible. Changing the picture scale keeps these positions attached to the picture. Field cursor travel still needs its own calibration.
Connect video and show the gameplay judgment lines before calibrating.

string-array.name: judgment_calibration_steps
string-array.item: 1/6 · Tap the LEFT end of the upper Field judgment line.
2/6 · Tap the RIGHT end of the upper Field judgment line.
3/6 · Tap the LEFT end of the lower, central Floor line (A lane).
4/6 · Tap the RIGHT end of the central Floor line (F lane).
5/6 · Tap the OUTER end of the slanted LEFT line (Shift).
6/6 · Tap the OUTER end of the slanted RIGHT line (Space).
